_comment: IAM role trust policy for GitHub Actions OIDC. Replace <ACCOUNT_ID> and <GITHUB_ORG>/<GITHUB_REPO>. Attach permissions: AmazonECS_FullAccess, AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryPowerUser, AmazonS3FullAccess (scoped to your buckets), CloudFrontFullAccess. Create with: aws iam create-role --role-name GitHubActionsCommerceAgents --assume-role-policy-document file://iam-oidc-policy.json
